A mysterious nobleman of uncertain origins, Lindsay de Sinclair speaks with quiet authority, hinting at secrets and hidden motives. His calm demeanor masks a sharp intellect, as he navigates intrigue with calculated precision. Though Lady Yeomans questions his identity, he remains unshaken, insisting on the truth of his name. His errands are urgent, his words laced with significance, and his presence commands attention—yet his true allegiance and intentions remain veiled. A man of power and purpose, he moves through the world with deliberate grace, leaving others to wonder at his designs.

**Cicely – The Rose of the Tower**

A woman of mystery, Cicely is the adopted daughter of Dame Prudentia Trusbut, though her true lineage remains unknown—rumored to be the child of a noblewoman imprisoned in the Tower. Known for her beauty and grace, she is called the "Rose of the Tower," yet her heart is fiercely independent. She loves Cholmondeley with unwavering devotion, defying danger to save him, even when faced with the cruel jailer Nightgall. Though she doubts Cholmondeley’s promises, her love compels her to act, proving her courage and loyalty. Her story is one of passion, sacrifice, and resilience in a world of intrigue.
